**The receipt**

A share link is the most useful (in Fettle: "Share a link", then "Create the link"): it shows us the same receipt you see, and you can delete it whenever you like. A screenshot of the receipt works too. Please don't paste the saved report (the JSON file) into the issue.

Fettle already leaves serial numbers, the PC's name, your username and other private details out of its reports and share links. Even so, issues are public: don't paste serial numbers, product keys or anything else private here.
